tasks.short: Write scientific articles to share findings

steps.what: Select research findings, verify sources and define the scientific article argument
Write the scientific article from the verified argument and results

loop.purpose: Word a manuscript from the scientist's established findings
loop.input: Verified article brief, selected results and checked references
loop.output: Source-linked manuscript draft with explicit gaps
loop.check: Scientist checks scientific meaning, method fidelity, uncertainty, novelty claims and every citation against original evidence
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unsupported claims or references require manual completion
loop.why_not_simpler: Scientific argument requires variable narrative wording; templates cover headings and fixed metadata

steps.what: Verify the article, resolve coauthor comments and submit the accepted manuscript

tasks.design: Use a bounded manuscript draft in {DOCS} from verified findings held in {OTHER}, the electronic laboratory notebook. The scientist retains argument selection, coauthor resolution and submission through {OTHER}, the journal submission system.
tasks.previous_blocker: The established scientific argument still needed substantial first-draft wording.
tasks.enabler_now: A source-bounded draft can reuse verified findings without inventing results.
tasks.still_hard: Correct facts can be arranged into an overstated or misleading scientific claim.
tasks.human_edge: Decide what the research establishes and take responsibility for its public presentation.
tasks.altitude: Less manuscript wording; scientific authorship and publication responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Review the interpretation of a research manuscript
reach.learn: How to distinguish exploratory findings from supported conclusions

evidence.claim: Benchling AI drafts notebook entries and study reports; this supports source-based scientific drafting capability, not demonstrated journal-article quality or local savings.
The manuscript workflow and time reductions are an unmeasured local design.

assumptions: Boundary uses the article-writing branch of this task, excluding original experiments, analysis and live conference delivery. A presentation-only case needs its own time mix and earns no live delivery saving.

The scientist creates the argument, result selection, figure versions, method facts, uncertainty statements, citation identifiers and publication constraints in s1; all capture and verification occupy 30 hours. Missing references are retrieved and checked manually rather than invented. Coauthors produce comments after s2 and before s3 closes; existing coauthor review effort remains unchanged outside this focal denominator.

Test approved native notebook and document drafting before custom code. OTHER is the laboratory notebook in s1 and journal submission system in s3. No model receives confidential material without approved access.
unknowns: Actual manuscript versus conference presentation mix
research_questions: Does source-bounded drafting reduce writing time after checking scientific meaning and every reference?

already_counted.description: Argument, source verification and brief capture
Scientific check, coauthor resolution and submission

approvals.approved_version: Exact manuscript, figures, sources, coauthor acceptance and submission metadata sent to the journal; any change voids acceptance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=30+31.5+25=86.5, gross=13.5, focal upkeep=6, net=7.5. Range 0-3 allows substantial original argument development, coauthor changes or a presentation-heavy task mix.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Teach or advise undergraduate or graduate students and supervise their research

tasks.design: Retain teaching, advice and research supervision with the scientist. Existing work in {DOCS} supports interaction; no separate material-preparation or tracking baseline is established.
tasks.previous_blocker: Student understanding and research decisions require responsive explanation and observation.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability establishes a shorter human teaching or supervisory action.
tasks.still_hard: A student can reproduce a procedure without understanding its scientific limitations.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize misconceptions and guide the student toward independent judgement.
tasks.altitude: Teaching and supervisory responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Demonstrate a laboratory method to a learner
reach.learn: How to check understanding through observed execution

evidence.claim: Responsive teaching and research supervision remain human work without a supported separate administrative reduction.

assumptions: Boundary is instruction and supervision, excluding original student research, separate grading and material production. Other participants' work stays unchanged outside this denominator.

The scientist supplies objectives before instruction; students supply questions and work before or during s1, before understanding is clarified. Verification and feedback are counted within its full time; no free competent-student flag is assumed.
Native material access precedes code. No new service or transferred work is proposed, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Current teaching and research supervision responsibilities
research_questions: Which misconceptions require direct demonstration or discussion to resolve?

already_counted.description: Instruction, student work review and clarification

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0 and net=0. Teaching contact and supervision retain their full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Study physical principles of living systems

steps.what: Define questions and methods for studying physical principles of living cells or organisms
Study cellular electrical or mechanical behavior through scientific investigation
Interpret the observations using mathematics, physics, chemistry or biology

tasks.design: Keep research questions, scientific investigation and interpretation with the scientist. {DOCS} retains the plan and evidence; this broad task does not establish a specific repeated calculation or pipeline to automate.
tasks.previous_blocker: An appropriate model and method depend on the biological question and experimental conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability establishes a reduction in the stated scientific judgement actions.
tasks.still_hard: A good mathematical fit may not identify the physical mechanism.
tasks.human_edge: Design informative investigations and distinguish explanation from correlation or measurement artifact.
tasks.altitude: Research responsibility and scientific decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Evaluate a mechanistic interpretation of experimental evidence

evidence.claim: Broad mechanistic research does not establish a specific reducible routine-analysis baseline; scientific design and interpretation remain human judgement.

assumptions: Boundary is scientific study, excluding separately counted manuscript production and a later customer-specific analysis pipeline. No generic paperwork or instrument-runtime saving is invented.

The scientist produces the plan in s1 and observations during s2 before s3 interpretation. Sample identities, measurement conditions and uncertainty are verified and captured within retained investigation time; no free structured mechanism or valid-model flag is assumed.
Test native scientific analysis tools before custom code if a repeated calculation is later specified. No new service is proposed, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Actual methods, instruments and repeated analysis operations
research_questions: Which specific repeated analysis operation can be isolated without changing experiment design or interpretation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0 and net=0. No repeated calculation share is assumed from a broad research statement.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Manage laboratory teams and work quality

steps.what: Review laboratory team work and investigate quality concerns
Manage laboratory teams through work direction, feedback and quality clarification

tasks.design: Retain work quality assessment and team direction with the scientist. {OTHER}, the laboratory notebook system, supplies existing records; no separate dashboard assembly or roster baseline is established.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recorded completion does not establish scientific quality or staff understanding.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability establishes a reduction in the stated assessment and management actions.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected results can reflect a new finding, a method problem or an execution error.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve scientific and interpersonal issues without reducing quality to a completion score.
tasks.altitude: Team management and scientific authority remain unchanged.

reach.learn: What context is necessary for a fair quality assessment

evidence.claim: SciSure provides laboratory tracking and workflows; tracking capability does not by itself replace scientific quality review or team management.

assumptions: Boundary is scientist quality review and management, excluding staff execution and separate student supervision. Other-role work remains unchanged outside the denominator.

Laboratory staff produce records before s1; the scientist checks sample, method version, provenance and deviations within its 50 hours. Staff supply questions and responses during s2 before directions close. No structured acceptable-work or staff-performance flag is assumed.
OTHER means the laboratory notebook system. Test native record visibility before code. No new monitoring or work transfer is proposed, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Current quality review and management responsibilities
research_questions: Which quality concerns cannot be resolved from completion records alone?

approvals.approved_version: Exact work assessment, team member, method context and direction communicated; changed evidence requires renewed direction.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0 and net=0. Scientific quality assessment and team direction retain their full shares.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Source-bounded manuscript drafting may shrink; teaching, scientific investigation and laboratory leadership retain their time.
reach: Review mechanistic reasoning with a physicist
Discuss laboratory evidence quality with a biological technician
role.ambitious_version: A scientist who communicates verified findings efficiently while preserving responsibility for experiments, interpretation and people.
